name: kujo-openai
description: Requires Kujo installed locally. Ability tools and evidence; native-only distribution is not yet available.

interface.longDescription: Requires Kujo installed locally for the planned native-only plugin. Discover registered Kujo Abilities, run authorized checks, and inspect execution receipts on supported local clients. This development package still uses Node and its review setup uses Git; it does not yet implement the preinstalled-only product. Available workflows depend on the configured Ability catalog. Local filesystem access requires an explicitly selected project and a verified host execution boundary. ChatGPT web/mobile local access and public local-MCP distribution are not claimed.
defaultPrompt: Review the changes I have made with Kujo.
Inspect the configured repository with Kujo.
Show me the evidence behind this Kujo result.
